answer: Each identity has a plume fading in one epoch unless a client renews it. Joining locks 40 credits on the marble ledger. A renewal lists a work receipt, funds origin, and 50-credit fee on the prism board. Auditors reject operator-funded renewals and burn the bond, checking the marble ledger for renewals per client and funds independence. The k-th fake needs a new client, receipt, and 90 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 clients and 90,000 credits per epoch. Rented clients fail: the ledger shows one client behind many renewals. Honest identities lock 40 once, with renewal paid in normal work.
